issues.legal_issue: Whether the lands assigned under the revised assignment policy were granted free of market value and subject to a condition prohibiting alienation.

Whether permissions under Section 47 and validation of sale transactions under Section 50-B of the Telangana Tenancy Act establish that the assigned lands were granted on payment of market value and are outside the prohibition on transfer under the Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfer) Act.

Whether the High Court’s judgments should be set aside and the writ petitions remanded for fresh consideration in light of the applicable assignment policy and the decisions in Gudepu Sailoo and Yadaiah.
